text.formatted: On each of its turns, the spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
text.plain: On each of its turns, the spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

text.formatted: The spy deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the spy that isn't Incapacitated and the spy doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.
